interpret_reference_object: interpret a logical form to find matching reference object memories in the agent memory graph
get_special_reference_object: retrieve a special reference object like AGENT SELF or SPEAKER_LOOK from agent memory
filter_by_sublocation: filter candidate reference objects by relative spatial location such as left of or inside
object_looked_at: find which object a player or entity is currently looking at from a list of candidates
apply_memory_filters: apply memory filter criteria to return all matching reference object nodes from agent memory
